categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the automotive parts manufacturing industry, focusing on automotive sensors and accessories, fuel system components, automotive interior parts, new energy vehicle components, and automotive thermal management system parts. It has expanded its business scope through the acquisition of a controlling stake in Bonair, enhancing its presence in automotive air conditioning and thermal management. The company serves both traditional fuel vehicles and new energy vehicles, including hybrid, extended-range, and pure electric models.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced sensor technologies including MEMS and MSG for high-precision automotive sensors such as pressure, current, and position sensors. It employs in-house production for high-technology, complex sensor products while outsourcing simpler fuel system and interior parts to qualified external manufacturers under strict quality control. The company also develops proprietary technologies like AMB silicon nitride copper-clad substrates for high-voltage electric vehicles and integrates digital tools like PLM and MES systems to optimize production and R&D processes.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major domestic and international automotive OEMs such as Chery, NIO, XPeng, BYD, Great Wall Motors, SAIC General Motors, and Geely. The company also supplies tier-1 automotive parts suppliers like United Automotive Electronics and BorgWarner. Its products cater to the automotive manufacturing sector, especially in the new energy vehicle market, commercial vehicles, and emerging segments like flying cars.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with headquarters and multiple manufacturing bases in Jiangsu Province and other regions. It has overseas subsidiaries and investments in Europe, including Germany and Poland, through its holding company in Luxembourg. Domestic sales dominate, accounting for over 95% of revenue, with exports constituting a smaller but growing portion.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the automotive supply chain as a manufacturer of core automotive components and systems. It engages in upstream R&D and manufacturing of sensors and parts, and downstream sales directly to OEMs and tier-1 suppliers. It also manages procurement and quality control of raw materials and outsourced production, integrating vertically through acquisitions to extend its product portfolio.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include advancing sensor technology innovation, expanding new energy vehicle component offerings, and deepening integration in automotive thermal management. The company emphasizes domestic sensor technology localization to reduce reliance on imports, invests heavily in R&D (over 3.6% of revenue), and pursues digital transformation with AI and data-driven management. It aims to optimize cost structures, improve quality control, and enhance supply chain efficiency while fostering talent development and knowledge management.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through direct sales of automotive parts and components under annual framework supply contracts with OEMs and tier-1 suppliers. The company follows a 'sales-driven production' model, recognizing revenue upon transfer of control to customers. It also earns investment income from equity holdings and financial assets, but product sales constitute the core revenue stream.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as one of the leading domestic manufacturers of automotive oil level sensors and related components, competing with international suppliers in the sensor market. It holds a strong market share in China’s automotive sensor sector, especially in MEMS-based products, and is expanding its footprint in new energy vehicle parts and thermal management systems. Competitors include global sensor manufacturers and automotive parts suppliers, but the company differentiates through technology localization and integrated product offerings.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.67 billion, a 48.87% increase year-over-year, driven by the consolidation of Bonair and growth in new energy vehicle components. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 137.88 million, up 11.31%. Total assets reached RMB 4.1 billion, growing 42.88%, with equity of RMB 2.06 billion. The company shows a strong growth trajectory supported by strategic acquisitions and expanding product lines.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-precision, reliable, and cost-effective automotive sensors and components tailored for both traditional and new energy vehicles. Its proprietary MEMS and MSG technologies enable superior performance in harsh automotive environments, supporting domestic substitution of imported parts. Integration of sensor, fuel system, interior, and thermal management products offers customers comprehensive solutions. The company’s rapid R&D response, quality assurance, and close collaboration with leading OEMs enhance its competitive advantage.
